text: 道指涨超550点！医疗消费股走强，芯片股续跌，中概股普涨，美油涨逾3% 美国劳工统计局公布，9月PPI环比上涨1.3%。
text_en: Dow rises over 550 points! Healthcare and consumer stocks strengthen, chip stocks continue to fall, Chinese concept stocks broadly gain, US crude oil rises over 3%. US Bureau of Labor Statistics reports September PPI up 1.3% month-on-month.
